====PLAN START====
TASK: Fix four Cut Lab card-classification bugs in the DeckFlow repo (branch feat/cutlab-fixes, worktree already checked out at repo root).

EXPECTED OUTCOME:
1. An MDFC (modal double-faced) card with a land back face (e.g. a Spell // Land MDFC) is counted in the "lands" role, not missed.
2. Cut Lab's role classification reads front-face oracle text first (matching how Manabase/PlanRoleClassifier already do it), not joined-all-faces text first — so back-face text no longer bleeds into a card's role.
3. Raugrin Triome (and every other cycling card) is NOT classified as "draw" just because its Cycling reminder text contains the literal phrase "Draw a card". The shared literal-draw regex must ignore text inside parentheses (reminder text), since MTG reminder text is always parenthesized on Scryfall oracle_text.
4. A card that matches none of Cut Lab's 8 structural roles falls into a new "Other" display bucket in the "How Your Pool Competes" panel instead of silently vanishing from every role count — WITHOUT becoming a floor/lockable role (see MUST NOT below — this is a display-only bucket).
5. `dotnet build` is clean, the full DeckFlow.Core.Tests + DeckFlow.Web.Tests suites pass, and new regression tests exist for each of the 4 fixes above (including a literal Raugrin Triome cycling-text test case and an MDFC land test case).

CONTEXT (read these first, in this order):
- docs/decisions/0003-ramp-classifier-divergence.md — ADR governing this area. Ramp classifiers (DeckStatClassifier.IsRampCard vs Manabase's ramp predicates) are INTENTIONALLY divergent — do not touch/unify ramp. Draw (DeckStatClassifier.MatchesYouCardDraw) is the INTENTIONALLY SHARED literal-draw signal used by both Cut Lab and Manabase (ManabaseClassifier.IsYouCardDraw delegates to it) — fixing a genuine bug in it is in scope and desired, but the ADR explicitly warns changes here can shift Manabase's golden/byte-identity tests and land-target math and must be re-verified, never assumed unaffected.
- DeckFlow.Web/Services/CutLab/CutLabRoleAssigner.cs — the role-assignment method (AssignRoles), lines ~63-131. This is where fixes 1, 2, 4 (assignment side) land.
- DeckFlow.Core/Analysis/DeckStatClassifier.cs — YouCardDrawRegex (~line 24-26) and MatchesYouCardDraw (~line 55) and IsDrawCard (~line 62-65). This is where fix 3 lands.
- DeckFlow.Core/Manabase/CardFact.cs — has `HasLandFace` (bool) and `FrontFaceOracleText` (string?) already correctly populated for MDFC/DFC cards by ScryfallCardFactMapper.cs (HasLandFace method ~line 84, and OracleText/FrontFaceOracleText assembly ~lines 39-42, 70-82). Do NOT change ScryfallCardFactMapper or CardFact — the data is already correct; Cut Lab just isn't reading it right.
- DeckFlow.Web/Services/Manabase/PlanRoleClassifier.cs line ~176 — the sibling classifier that ALREADY does `fact.FrontFaceOracleText ?? fact.OracleText ?? string.Empty` (front-face-first). Cut Lab's CutLabRoleAssigner.cs line ~73 currently has the operands REVERSED (`fact.OracleText ?? fact.FrontFaceOracleText`) — this is the "align with Manabase" bug. Also see ManabaseClassifier.cs lines ~1097, ~1156, ~1841 for the same front-face-first pattern used elsewhere in Manabase.
- DeckFlow.Web/Services/CutLab/CutLabLockRules.cs — `IsLand(typeLine)` (~line 102) checks only the front-face type line via `CardTypeLine.FrontFace`. Do not change this method itself (it's correctly front-face-only for its OTHER callers) — instead, CutLabRoleAssigner must OR it with `fact.HasLandFace` locally.
- DeckFlow.Web/Services/CutLab/CutLabFloorRules.cs — `RoleKeys` (the 8 canonical floor-eligible role keys) and `TryGetCanonicalRole`. **DO NOT add "other" to this list** (see MUST NOT).
- DeckFlow.Web/Services/CutLab/CutLabFloorDefaults.cs — `GetBracketBand(role, bracket)` (~line 101-125) has a switch over role name with `_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(...)` as the default case. If "other" were ever added to `CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys`, `ResolveDefaults`'s `foreach (string role in CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys)` loop would call this and THROW on every single Cut Lab page load. This is exactly why "other" must stay out of `CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys`.
- DeckFlow.Web/Models/CutLabViewModel.cs:
  - `RoleDisplayLabels` dict (~line 39-50) — add `["other"] = "Other"`.
  - `BuildRoleGroups` (~line 373-404) — currently does `CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys.Select(roleKey => ...)`. Change it to iterate a NEW local display-order list that is `CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys` followed by `"other"` — mirror the EXACT existing pattern used a few lines below for `TypeGroupOrder` (~line 52-64: a separate `private static readonly string[] TypeGroupOrder = [...​, "Other"]` array, decoupled from `CardTypeLine.PrimaryTypePriority`, with a comment noting it appends the fallback bucket). Do the same thing here: add e.g. `private static readonly string[] RoleGroupDisplayOrder = [.. CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys, "other"];` (or a plain literal array duplicating the 8 keys + "other" — match whichever style keeps it simplest) and have `BuildRoleGroups` iterate that instead of `CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys` directly. The `.Where(card => ... roles.Contains(roleKey, ...))` membership logic inside the select does not need to change — a card with `["other"]` in its assigned-roles list will naturally show up under roleKey `"other"`.
  - `BuildFloorRows` (~line 445+) and anywhere else that iterates `CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys` directly for floor logic must be LEFT UNCHANGED — floors/locks remain exactly the original 8 roles.
- DeckFlow.Web.Tests/CutLabRoleAssignerTests.cs — existing test file/conventions to extend (uses a `Fact(...)` test helper — read the file to find its signature before writing new tests).
- DeckFlow.Core.Tests/DeckStatClassifierTests.cs — existing `IsDrawCard_TrueCases`/`IsDrawCard_FalseCases` theory tests (~lines 45-65) to extend with a cycling-reminder-text false-positive case.

CONSTRAINTS:
- C# 12 / .NET 10, existing project conventions (file-scoped namespaces, XML doc comments on public members, `sealed`/`static` as already used in these files).
- Preserve each touched file's existing line endings exactly (LF or CRLF, per-file — do not assume a repo-wide style; check each file before editing). Change only the lines whose content actually changes.
- xUnit conventions: `[Theory]`/`[InlineData]` where the file already uses them, `[Fact]` otherwise, matching each file's existing style exactly.
- Do NOT touch DeckStatClassifier.IsRampCard or any Manabase ramp predicate — ramp stays intentionally divergent per ADR 0003.
- Do NOT change ScryfallCardFactMapper.cs or CardFact.cs — MDFC/land-face data is already correct there.

MUST DO:
1. In `CutLabRoleAssigner.AssignRoles`: change `bool isLand = CutLabLockRules.IsLand(typeLine);` to also OR in `fact.HasLandFace` (e.g. `bool isLand = CutLabLockRules.IsLand(typeLine) || fact.HasLandFace;`), and change the ramp gate a few lines below (`if (!CutLabLockRules.IsLand(typeLine) && DeckStatClassifier.IsRampCard(typeLine, oracle))`) to reuse the local `isLand` variable instead of recomputing (`if (!isLand && DeckStatClassifier.IsRampCard(typeLine, oracle))`) — otherwise an MDFC land could double-count as both "lands" and "ramp".
2. In the same method, swap the oracle-text precedence: `string oracle = fact.OracleText ?? fact.FrontFaceOracleText ?? string.Empty;` → `string oracle = fact.FrontFaceOracleText ?? fact.OracleText ?? string.Empty;`.
3. In `DeckStatClassifier.cs`: add a private helper that strips parenthetical reminder text (regex `\([^)]*\)` → empty, or equivalent) and apply it inside `MatchesYouCardDraw` before running `YouCardDrawRegex` (e.g. `internal static bool MatchesYouCardDraw(string oracleText) => YouCardDrawRegex.IsMatch(StripReminderText(oracleText));`). Add an XML doc / inline comment explaining why (cycling's "(..., Discard this card: Draw a card.)" reminder text was a false positive for every cycling card, e.g. Raugrin Triome). Do not change `IsRampCard`.
4. Add the "other" fallback: in `CutLabRoleAssigner.AssignRoles`, after building the `assigned` list, if it is empty, add a new `OtherRole = "other"` constant to the assigned list before returning. Wire the display side exactly as described in CONTEXT above (RoleDisplayLabels + new display-order array in CutLabViewModel.cs) — do NOT touch CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys.
5. Add regression tests:
   - CutLabRoleAssignerTests.cs: an MDFC Spell // Land card (e.g. a fictional "Test Spell // Test Land" fact with `HasLandFace = true` and front-face type line NOT containing "Land") asserts `roles` contains "lands" and does NOT contain "ramp". A card whose `OracleText` (joined) contains draw text only on a back face but whose `FrontFaceOracleText` does not, asserts "draw" is NOT in the result. A card matching none of the 8 roles (e.g. a vanilla noncreature/nonland with no matching oracle text) asserts `roles` equals exactly `["other"]`.
   - DeckStatClassifierTests.cs: a literal Raugrin-Triome-style oracle text (tri-land: "(Tapland) enters the battlefield tapped.\n{T}: Add {R}, {U}, or {W}.\nCycling {3} ({3}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)") asserts `DeckStatClassifier.IsDrawCard(...)` is `false`. Keep existing true-case coverage (e.g. a card whose non-reminder-text body literally says "Draw a card") passing unchanged.
6. Run `dotnet build` (repo root — check for the correct dotnet invocation; if WSL/Windows path issues arise, look for scripts/ helpers) and confirm 0 errors, 0 new warnings.
7. Run the full DeckFlow.Core.Tests and DeckFlow.Web.Tests suites (`dotnet test`) and confirm all pass, INCLUDING any Manabase golden/byte-identity tests (grep for "golden" or "ByteIdentity" in DeckFlow.Core.Tests/DeckFlow.Web.Tests if unsure which suite they're in) — the shared draw-regex change (fix #3) can in principle shift Manabase output per ADR 0003. If any Manabase test fails or a golden snapshot changes as a result of the reminder-text fix, STOP, do not modify/rebaseline the golden file yourself, and report it clearly under DONE_WITH_CONCERNS with the exact failing test name and diff — this needs human review, not silent rebaselining.
8. Grep the codebase for any other place that reads `CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys` or the 8-key role list to confirm nothing else needs updating for the new "other" role (e.g. any TS/cshtml that hardcodes the 8 roles) and report what you found even if nothing needed changing.

MUST NOT:
- Do not add "other" to `CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys` (breaks `CutLabFloorDefaults.GetBracketBand` — see CONTEXT).
- Do not touch ramp classification (DeckStatClassifier.IsRampCard, any ManabaseClassifier ramp predicate) — ADR 0003 forbids unifying/changing these in this task.
- Do not touch ScryfallCardFactMapper.cs or CardFact.cs.
- Do not rebaseline/regenerate any Manabase golden test snapshot files yourself if the draw-regex fix shifts them — flag it instead.
- Do not commit. Leave changes uncommitted in the working tree for Claude to review and commit.
- Do not spawn subagents.

  1097	        string text = card.FrontFaceOracleText ?? card.OracleText ?? string.Empty;
  1098	        if (text.Length == 0)
  1099	        {
  1100	            return null;
  1101	        }
  1102	
  1103	        string normalizedText = ReminderTextRegex.Replace(text, string.Empty);
  1104	
  1105	        // Instant/sorcery rituals with any Sacrifice clause carry an additional cost or downside
  1106	        // the sim cannot model, so exclude them conservatively per SPEC §3.1.

  1109	            return null;
  1110	        }
  1111

  1113	        if (!add.Success)
  1114	        {
  1115	            return null;
  1116	        }
  1117

  1119	        ParsedManaCost own = ManaCostParser.Parse(card.ManaCost);

  1121	        {
  1122	            return null;
  1123	        }
  1124

  1126	        if (produced.ManaValue - own.ManaValue <= 0)
  1127	        {
  1128	            return null;
  1129	        }

  1132	        if (colors.Count == 0)
  1133	        {
  1134	            return null;
  1135	        }
  1136	
  1137	        return new OneShotMana
  1138	        {
  1139	            Name = card.Name,
  1140	            ProducedColors = colors,
  1141	            ProducedAmount = produced.ManaValue,
  1142	            OwnPips = own.Pips,
  1143	            OwnManaValue = own.ManaValue,
  1144	        };
  1145	    }
  1146	
  1147	    // A repeatable, self-contained mana ability on the card's FRONT face: an activated
  1148	    // "<cost>: Add ..." line whose cost does not sacrifice anything. The sacrifice check drops
  1149	    // one-shot mana (Lotus Petal "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add ...") and sac-outlet engines

  1157	        if (text.Length == 0)
  1158	        {
  1159	            return false;
  1160	        }
  1161	
  1162	        text = ReminderTextRegex.Replace(text, string.Empty);
  1163	        foreach (string rawLine in text.Split('\n'))
  1164	        {

  1166	            // ability — evaluate the QUOTED ability's cost/effect. Other-grants are skipped.
  1167	            foreach (Match quote in QuotedSpanRegex.Matches(rawLine))

  1839	    private static bool HasNonOneShotFrontAdd(CardFact card)
  1840	    {
  1841	        string text = card.FrontFaceOracleText ?? card.OracleText ?? string.Empty;
  1842	        if (text.Length == 0)
  1843	        {
  1844	            return false;
  1845	        }
  1846	
  1847	        text = ReminderTextRegex.Replace(text, string.Empty);
  1848	        foreach (string line in text.Split('\n'))
  1849	        {
  1850	            int add = line.IndexOf("Add ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
  1851	            if (add < 0)
  1852	            {
  1853	                continue;
  1854	            }
  1855	
  1856	            // An "Add" preceded on the same line by a "<cost>: " whose cost sacrifices is one-shot
  1857	            // (Lotus Bloom) or a sac-outlet (Ashnod's Altar) — skip it; keep scanning other lines.
  1858	            int colon = line.IndexOf(':', StringComparison.Ordinal);
  1859	            if (colon >= 0 && colon < add
  1860	                && line[..colon].Contains("Sacrifice", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))

     8	/// Assigns each pool card to zero or more of Cut Lab's eight structural role keys using only the
     9	/// existing role and deck-stat classifiers. This taxonomy is wider than <see cref="PlanRole"/>:
    10	/// lands, ramp, and filler draw still matter for slot competition even though
    11	/// <see cref="PlanRoleClassifier"/> deliberately excludes them from plan-presence roles. Multi-role
    12	/// membership is allowed; cutting a card reduces every role count it currently fills.
    13	/// </summary>
    14	public static class CutLabRoleAssigner
    15	{
    16	    private const string LandsRole = "lands";
    17	    private const string RampRole = "ramp";
    18	    private const string DrawRole = "draw";
    19	    private const string InteractionRole = "interaction";
    20	    private const string ProtectionRole = "protection";

    28	        RampRole,

    30	        InteractionRole,
    31	        ProtectionRole,
    32	        EnginesRole,

    55	    /// <summary>
    56	    /// Assigns the fixed-order Cut Lab role keys for a card using only existing classifier signals.
    57	    /// </summary>
    58	    /// <param name="fact">Resolved card fact.</param>
    59	    /// <param name="categories">Crowd-sourced category tags for the card.</param>
    60	    /// <param name="isComboPiece">Whether Commander Spellbook lists the card in an included combo.</param>
    61	    /// <param name="mode">Classifier mode derived from play experience.</param>
    62	    /// <returns>The subset of role keys the card fills, in canonical order.</returns>
    63	    public static IReadOnlyList<string> AssignRoles(
    64	        CardFact fact,
    65	        IReadOnlyList<string> categories,
    66	        bool isComboPiece,
    67	        ManabaseMode mode)
    68	    {
    69	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(fact);
    70	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(categories);
    71	
    72	        string typeLine = fact.TypeLine;
    73	        string oracle = fact.OracleText ?? fact.FrontFaceOracleText ?? string.Empty;
    74	        bool isLand = CutLabLockRules.IsLand(typeLine);
    75	        PlanRole roles = PlanRoleClassifier.Classify(fact, categories, isComboPiece, mode, out bool interactionMeritPreGate);
    76	
    77	        List<string> assigned = new(RoleKeys.Length);
    78	
    79	        if (isLand)
    80	        {
    81	            assigned.Add(LandsRole);
    82	        }
    83	
    84	        // Why: DeckStatClassifier.IsRampCard first returns true for every type line containing
    85	        // "Land", so without the gate every land would double-count as ramp and inflate downstream
    86	        // role counts. Lands and ramp stay disjoint by construction.

    88	        {
    89	            assigned.Add(RampRole);
    90	        }
    91	
    92	        if (DeckStatClassifier.IsDrawCard(oracle))
    93	        {
    94	            assigned.Add(DrawRole);
    95	        }
    96	
    97	        if (interactionMeritPreGate
    98	            || DeckStatClassifier.IsBoardWipeCard(oracle)
    99	            || DeckStatClassifier.IsTargetedRemovalCard(typeLine, oracle))
   100	        {
   101	            assigned.Add(InteractionRole);
   102	        }
   103	
   104	        if (DeckStatClassifier.IsProtectionCard(fact.Name, oracle))
   105	        {
   106	            assigned.Add(ProtectionRole);
   107	        }
   108	
   109	        // Why: the shared PlanRoleClassifier keeps Engine on one-shot card advantage for the manabase
   110	        // plan-presence lens (locked 2026-07-09), but Cut Lab's role display wants true repeatable
   111	        // engines. Gate locally on permanent + repeatable draw, mirroring FromHeuristic's Engine rule,
   112	        // so one-shot "draw two" spells tagged "card draw"/"value" no longer flood the engines role.
   113	        if (roles.HasFlag(PlanRole.Engine)
   114	            && !CardTypeLine.IsNonPermanentFront(typeLine)
   115	            && DeckStatClassifier.IsDrawCard(oracle))
   116	        {
   117	            assigned.Add(EnginesRole);
   118	        }
   119	
   120	        if (roles.HasFlag(PlanRole.Payoff))
   121	        {
   122	            assigned.Add(PayoffsRole);
   123	        }
   124	
   125	        if (DeckStatClassifier.IsClosingPowerCard(typeLine, oracle) || isComboPiece)
   126	        {
   127	            assigned.Add(WinconsRole);
   128	        }
   129	
   130	        return assigned;
   131	    }

     4	/// Maps a Scryfall card payload (<see cref="ScryfallCardData"/>) to a <see cref="CardFact"/>
     5	/// for the mana-base classifier. Pure mapping — no HTTP. Handles multi-faced cards: the
     6	/// front face drives the cast cost/type, oracle text is joined across faces (so the back's
     7	/// "enters tapped" / land type is visible), and a land on any face sets
     8	/// <see cref="CardFact.HasLandFace"/>.
     9	/// </summary>
    10	public static class ScryfallCardFactMapper
    11	{
    12	    /// <summary>Map one Scryfall card plus its deck quantity to a <see cref="CardFact"/>.</summary>
    13	    /// <param name="card">The Scryfall payload.</param>
    14	    /// <param name="quantity">Copies of this card in the deck.</param>
    15	    /// <param name="isCommander">True if the card is in the command zone.</param>
    16	    public static CardFact ToCardFact(ScryfallCardData card, int quantity, bool isCommander = false)
    17	    {
    18	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(card);
    19	
    20	        ScryfallFaceData? front = card.CardFaces is { Count: > 0 } ? card.CardFaces[0] : null;
    21	
    22	        string typeLine = front?.TypeLine ?? card.TypeLine ?? string.Empty;
    23	        // Prefer the front face's printed cost for the castable side; fall back to card level.
    24	        string? manaCost = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(front?.ManaCost) ? front!.ManaCost : card.ManaCost;
    25	
    26	        // For multi-faced cards (split/aftermath/MDFC), Scryfall's root cmc is the COMBINED
    27	        // value (Commit // Memory = 10), but we cast the front face ({3}{U} = 4). Derive the
    28	        // value from the chosen front cost so the on-curve turn is right; single-faced cards
    29	        // keep Scryfall's authoritative cmc.
    30	        double manaValue = front is not null ? ManaCostParser.Parse(manaCost).ManaValue : card.Cmc;
    31	
    32	        return new CardFact
    33	        {
    34	            Name = card.Name,
    35	            Quantity = quantity,
    36	            ManaCost = manaCost,
    37	            ManaValue = manaValue,
    38	            TypeLine = typeLine,
    39	            OracleText = JoinOracleText(card),
    40	            // Front-face text only — so a front-face permanent with a one-shot mana adventure/back
    41	            // face does not read as repeatable ramp (MQ-03). Falls back to card-level for single-face.
    42	            FrontFaceOracleText = front?.OracleText ?? card.OracleText,
    43	            LandFaceOracleText = LandFaceOracleText(card),
    44	            ProducedMana = card.ProducedMana ?? Array.Empty<string>(),
    45	            Rarity = card.Rarity,
    46	            Layout = card.Layout,
    47	            HasLandFace = HasLandFace(card),
    48	            IsCommander = isCommander,
    49	            ManaAmount = ManaProductionAmount.Parse(JoinOracleText(card)),
    50	            Power = ParseFixedPower(front?.Power ?? card.Power),
    51	        };
    52	    }
    53	
    54	    // Parse a Scryfall printed power into a fixed int, or null when absent or variable ("*", "1+*",
    55	    // "X"). Only fixed numeric power feeds the "greatest power among creatures" cost reducer; a
    56	    // variable-power creature (a *goyf) contributes nothing, which is the conservative read.
    57	    private static int? ParseFixedPower(string? power) =>
    58	        int.TryParse(power, System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Integer,
    59	            System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out int value)
    60	            ? value
    61	            : null;

    66	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entries);

    70	    private static string JoinOracleText(ScryfallCardData card)
    71	    {
    72	        if (card.CardFaces is { Count: > 0 } faces)
    73	        {
    74	            IEnumerable<string> parts = faces
    75	                .Select(f => f.OracleText)
    76	                .Where(t => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t))!;
    77	            string joined = string.Join("\n", parts);
    78	            return joined.Length > 0 ? joined : card.OracleText ?? string.Empty;
    79	        }
    80	
    81	        return card.OracleText ?? string.Empty;
    82	    }

    84	    private static bool HasLandFace(ScryfallCardData card)
    85	    {
    86	        if (card.CardFaces is { Count: > 0 } faces)
    87	        {
    88	            // Only a face that is playable AS a land from hand counts (efficacy R2 M6). The FRONT
    89	            // face always does (Westvale Abbey, or a Land // Land MDFC). A BACK-face land is
    90	            // playable from hand only on a modal DFC (Malakir Rebirth // Malakir Mire); on a
    91	            // transform card (Search for Azcanta // Azcanta) the land back is reached only by
    92	            // flipping the front — not castable from hand — so it earns no color-source / land
    93	            // credit. The joined card-level type_line ("Enchantment // Land") is intentionally NOT
    94	            // used here because it leaks a transform back into the land count.

    96	            bool mdfcBackIsLand = faces.Count > 1
    97	                && string.Equals(card.Layout, "modal_dfc", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    98	                && ContainsLand(faces[1].TypeLine);
    99	            return frontIsLand || mdfcBackIsLand;
   100	        }
   101	
   102	        return ContainsLand(card.TypeLine);
   103	    }
   104	
   105	    private static string? LandFaceOracleText(ScryfallCardData card)
   106	    {
   107	        if (card.CardFaces is { Count: > 0 } faces)
   108	        {
   109	            if (ContainsLand(faces[0].TypeLine))
   110	            {
   111	                return faces[0].OracleText;
   112	            }
   113	
   114	            if (faces.Count > 1 && ContainsLand(faces[1].TypeLine))
   115	            {
   116	                return faces[1].OracleText;
   117	            }
   118	
   119	            return null;
   120	        }
   121	
   122	        return ContainsLand(card.TypeLine) ? card.OracleText : null;
   123	    }
   124	
   125	    private static bool ContainsLand(string? typeLine) =>
   126	        typeLine is not null && typeLine.Contains("Land", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

     1	using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
     2	
     3	namespace DeckFlow.Core.Analysis;
     4	
     5	/// <summary>
     6	/// Pure static deck-stat classifiers used to tally role counts (ramp, draw, interaction,
     7	/// board wipes, recursion, closing power) in a deck's mainboard.  These are pure CPU domain
     8	/// logic; their inputs (typeLine, oracleText) come from Scryfall card data.
     9	/// </summary>
    10	public static class DeckStatClassifier
    11	{
    12	    // A card-draw effect that benefits YOU (efficacy R2 M7). Matches "draw(s) a/N card(s)" —
    13	    // imperative ("Draw a card"), activated ("<cost>: Draw a card"), "you (may) draw…", and
    14	    // symmetric wheels ("each player draws seven cards", where you are a player too) — but EXCLUDES:
    15	    //   * draws attributed to an opponent or an indeterminate other player ("target/that/another
    16	    //     player draws", "opponent(s) draw"), which are not card advantage for the caster; and
    17	    //   * draw-as-CONDITION, where the draw is a trigger/replacement rather than an effect
    18	    //     ("whenever/when you draw a card, …" payoffs; "if you would draw a card, …" replacements) —
    19	    //     those cards do not themselves draw. A real ETB draw ("When this enters, draw a card") has
    20	    //     no "you" between the trigger word and "draw", so it is still matched.
    21	    // Handling "draws?" (with the plural s) is the point: a "…draws two cards" card is now seen the
    22	    // same by the v2 land-target credit (IsRepeatableRampOrDraw) and the budget draw count
    23	    // (IsDrawPieceForBudget), instead of one subsystem crediting it while the other ignores it.
    24	    private static readonly Regex YouCardDrawRegex = new(

   163	    /// <summary>
   164	    /// Oracle-text heuristic fallback for a card with no useful category tags and not a known combo
   165	    /// piece. Reuses the shared <see cref="DeckStatClassifier"/> signals. Engine requires a PERMANENT
   166	    /// draw source (repeatable) — a one-shot instant/sorcery "draw two" is filler, not an engine, and
   167	    /// stays None.
   168	    /// </summary>
   169	    /// <param name="fact">The resolved card (type line + oracle text).</param>
   170	    /// <param name="mode">Analysis profile; gates whether a pure counterspell earns Interaction.</param>
   171	    public static PlanRole FromHeuristic(CardFact fact, ManabaseMode mode)
   172	    {
   173	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(fact);
   174	
   175	        string typeLine = fact.TypeLine;
   176	        string oracle = fact.OracleText ?? fact.FrontFaceOracleText ?? string.Empty;
   177	
   178	        PlanRole roles = PlanRole.None;
   179	
   180	        if (DeckStatClassifier.IsClosingPowerCard(typeLine, oracle))
   181	        {
   182	            roles |= PlanRole.Payoff;
   183	        }
   184	
   185	        if (DeckStatClassifier.IsTutorCard(oracle))
   186	        {
   187	            roles |= PlanRole.TutorCombo;
   188	        }
   189	
   190	        if (GrantsInteraction(typeLine, oracle, mode))
   191	        {
   192	            roles |= PlanRole.Interaction;
   193	        }
   194	
   195	        // Repeatable draw only: a permanent that draws is an engine; a one-shot instant/sorcery draw
   196	        // is filler velocity (excluded, per the locked "filler draw never qualifies" decision).
   197	        bool isSpellOnTheStack = typeLine.Contains("Instant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
   198	            || typeLine.Contains("Sorcery", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
   199	        if (DeckStatClassifier.IsDrawCard(oracle) && !isSpellOnTheStack)
   200	        {
   201	            roles |= PlanRole.Engine;
   202	        }
   203	
   204	        return roles;
   205	    }

    99	    /// <summary>[ASSUMED] Unsigned product constants for non-lands, non-ramp, non-draw role floors.</summary>
   100	    /// <remarks>User-adjustable via FLOOR-02; chosen during planning and awaiting product sign-off.</remarks>
   101	    private static int GetBracketBand(string role, int bracket)
   102	    {
   103	        int normalizedBracket = bracket switch
   104	        {
   105	            <= 2 => 2,
   106	            3 => 3,
   107	            4 => 4,
   108	            _ => 5,
   109	        };
   110	
   111	        return role switch
   112	        {
   113	            // Why: higher brackets expect denser answers, so interaction climbs the fastest.
   114	            "interaction" => normalizedBracket switch { 2 => 6, 3 => 8, 4 => 10, _ => 12 },
   115	            // Why: protection scales with combo pressure but stays below interaction because it is narrower.
   116	            "protection" => normalizedBracket switch { 2 => 2, 3 => 3, 4 => 4, _ => 5 },
   117	            // Why: engine density rises through optimized play, then flattens because engines self-sustain.
   118	            "engines" => normalizedBracket switch { 2 => 4, 3 => 5, 4 => 6, _ => 6 },
   119	            // Why: payoffs track engines so plans have enough closers without overloading dead finishers.
   120	            "payoffs" => normalizedBracket switch { 2 => 4, 3 => 5, 4 => 6, _ => 6 },
   121	            // Why: most decks need only a small number of true wins even as optimization increases.
   122	            "wincons" => normalizedBracket switch { 2 => 2, 3 => 2, 4 => 3, _ => 3 },
   123	            _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(role), role, "Unsupported Cut Lab role key."),
   124	        };
   125	    }

   135	            }

   137	            overrides[floor.Role] = floor;
   138	        }

   140	        return overrides;
   141	    }

     7	/// route every proposed cut through Evaluate before presenting it — a proposed cut that breaks a
     8	/// floor always carries an explicit warning, never a silent break (FLOOR-02).
     9	/// </summary>
    10	public static class CutLabFloorRules
    11	{
    12	    /// <summary>Stable serialized role keys in the fixed Cut Lab display and persistence order.</summary>
    13	    public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> RoleKeys =
    14	    [
    15	        "lands",
    16	        "ramp",
    17	        "draw",

    25	    /// <summary>Maximum supported role floor after clamping untrusted persisted values.</summary>
    26	    // Why: Cut Lab accepts up to a 150-card non-commander pool, and the commander is the plus one.
    27	    public const int MaxFloor = CutLabPoolValidator.MaxPoolCards + 1;
    28	
    29	    /// <summary>Clamps, canonicalizes, and de-duplicates untrusted persisted role-floor entries.</summary>
    30	    /// <param name="state">Current Cut Lab working-session state.</param>
    31	    /// <returns>The original state when already valid; otherwise a copy with corrected role floors.</returns>
    32	    public static CutLabState ClampFloors(CutLabState state)
    33	    {
    34	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(state);
    35	
    36	        List<CutLabRoleFloor> normalized = [];
    37	        HashSet<string> seenRoles = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    38	        bool changed = false;
    39	
    40	        foreach (CutLabRoleFloor roleFloor in state.RoleFloors)
    41	        {
    42	            if (!TryGetCanonicalRole(roleFloor.Role, out string canonicalRole))
    43	            {
    44	                changed = true;
    45	                continue;
    46	            }
    47	
    48	            if (!seenRoles.Add(canonicalRole))
    49	            {
    50	                changed = true;
    51	                continue;
    52	            }
    53	
    54	            int clampedFloor = Math.Clamp(roleFloor.Floor, 0, MaxFloor);
    55	            bool entryChanged = clampedFloor != roleFloor.Floor
    56	                || !string.Equals(roleFloor.Role, canonicalRole, StringComparison.Ordinal);
    57	            changed |= entryChanged;
    58	            normalized.Add(entryChanged ? roleFloor with { Role = canonicalRole, Floor = clampedFloor } : roleFloor);
    59	        }
    60	
    61	        if (!changed)
    62	        {
    63	            return state;
    64	        }
    65	
    66	        return state with
    67	        {
    68	            RoleFloors = normalized,
    69	        };
    70	    }
    71	
    72	    /// <summary>Warning emitted when a proposed cut would drop a role below its floor.</summary>
    73	    public sealed record CutLabFloorWarning
    74	    {
    75	        /// <summary>Stable serialized role key whose floor would be broken.</summary>
    76	        public string Role { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    77	
    78	        /// <summary>Role count after applying the proposed cut.</summary>
    79	        public int NewCount { get; init; }
    80	
    81	        /// <summary>User-visible floor that would be broken.</summary>
    82	        public int Floor { get; init; }
    83	
    84	        /// <summary>Fixed UI warning copy for the proposed floor break.</summary>
    85	        public string Message { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    86	    }
    87	
    88	    /// <summary>Evaluates whether cutting a card would break any currently configured role floors.</summary>
    89	    /// <param name="roleCounts">Current role counts by stable role key.</param>
    90	    /// <param name="floors">Active floors by stable role key.</param>
    91	    /// <param name="candidateCutRoles">Every role the candidate cut card belongs to.</param>
    92	    /// <param name="cardName">Display name of the card being considered for cutting.</param>
    93	    /// <param name="quantity">Number of cards the proposed cut removes. Phase 103 must pass the real cut quantity.</param>
    94	    /// <returns>One warning per broken floor, or an empty list when the cut stays above all floors.</returns>
    95	    public static IReadOnlyList<CutLabFloorWarning> Evaluate(
    96	        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> roleCounts,
    97	        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> floors,
    98	        IReadOnlyCollection<string> candidateCutRoles,
    99	        string cardName,
   100	        int quantity = 1)
   101	    {
   102	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(roleCounts);
   103	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(floors);
   104	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(candidateCutRoles);
   105	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(cardName);
   106	
   107	        Dictionary<string, int> normalizedRoleCounts = NormalizeCounts(roleCounts);
   108	        Dictionary<string, int> normalizedFloors = NormalizeCounts(floors);
   109	        List<CutLabFloorWarning>? warnings = null;
   110	        HashSet<string> seenRoles = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
   111	
   112	        foreach (string candidateRole in candidateCutRoles)
   113	        {
   114	            if (!TryGetCanonicalRole(candidateRole, out string canonicalRole) || !seenRoles.Add(canonicalRole))
   115	            {
   116	                continue;
   117	            }
   118	
   119	            if (!normalizedFloors.TryGetValue(canonicalRole, out int floor))
   120	            {
   121	                continue;
   122	            }
   123	
   124	            int currentCount = normalizedRoleCounts.TryGetValue(canonicalRole, out int count) ? count : 0;
   125	            int newCount = Math.Max(0, currentCount - quantity);
   126	            if (newCount >= floor)
   127	            {
   128	                continue;
   129	            }
   130	
   131	            warnings ??= [];
   132	            warnings.Add(new CutLabFloorWarning
   133	            {
   134	                Role = canonicalRole,
   135	                NewCount = newCount,
   136	                Floor = floor,
   137	                Message = $"Cutting {cardName} drops {canonicalRole} to {newCount}, below your floor of {floor}.",
   138	            });
   139	        }
   140	
   141	        return warnings ?? [];
   142	    }
   143	
   144	    private static Dictionary<string, int> NormalizeCounts(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> values)
   145	    {
   146	        Dictionary<string, int> normalized = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
   147	        foreach ((string role, int value) in values)
   148	        {
   149	            if (TryGetCanonicalRole(role, out string canonicalRole))
   150	            {
   151	                normalized[canonicalRole] = value;
   152	            }
   153	        }
   154	
   155	        return normalized;
   156	    }
   157	
   158	    private static bool TryGetCanonicalRole(string? role, out string canonicalRole)
   159	    {
   160	        foreach (string candidate in RoleKeys)
   161	        {
   162	            if (string.Equals(candidate, role, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
   163	            {
   164	                canonicalRole = candidate;
   165	                return true;
   166	            }
   167	        }
   168	
   169	        canonicalRole = string.Empty;
   170	        return false;
   171	    }
   172	}

   373	    private static IReadOnlyList<CutLabRoleGroupView> BuildRoleGroups(
   374	        IReadOnlyList<CutLabPoolCard> pool,
   375	        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, IReadOnlyList<string>> roleAssignmentsByCardName)
   376	    {
   377	        return CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys
   378	            .Select(roleKey =>
   379	            {
   380	                IReadOnlyList<CutLabRoleMemberView> members = pool
   381	                    .Where(card => roleAssignmentsByCardName.TryGetValue(card.Name, out IReadOnlyList<string>? roles)
   382	                        && roles.Contains(roleKey, StringComparer.Ordinal))
   383	                    .Select(card => new CutLabRoleMemberView
   384	                    {
   385	                        Name = card.Name,
   386	                        IsLocked = card.IsLocked,
   387	                        IsCommander = card.IsCommander,
   388	                    })
   389	                    .ToArray();
   390	
   391	                return new CutLabRoleGroupView
   392	                {
   393	                    RoleKey = roleKey,
   394	                    DisplayLabel = DisplayLabelFor(roleKey),
   395	                    Members = members,
   396	                    LockedCount = pool
   397	                        .Where(card => card.IsLocked
   398	                            && roleAssignmentsByCardName.TryGetValue(card.Name, out IReadOnlyList<string>? roles)
   399	                            && roles.Contains(roleKey, StringComparer.Ordinal))
   400	                        .Sum(card => card.Quantity),
   401	                };
   402	            })
   403	            .ToArray();
   404	    }
   405	
   406	    private static IReadOnlyList<CutLabRoleGroupView> BuildTypeGroups(IReadOnlyList<CutLabPoolCard> pool)
   407	    {
   408	        // Bucket each card once by primary type, then order the present buckets by TypeGroupOrder.
   409	        // Single-pass so PrimaryType runs once per card rather than once per (type x card).
   410	        Dictionary<string, List<CutLabPoolCard>> byPrimaryType = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
   411	        foreach (CutLabPoolCard card in pool)
   412	        {
   413	            string primaryType = CardTypeLine.PrimaryType(card.TypeLine);
   414	            if (!byPrimaryType.TryGetValue(primaryType, out List<CutLabPoolCard>? bucket))
   415	            {
   416	                bucket = [];
   417	                byPrimaryType[primaryType] = bucket;
   418	            }
   419	
   420	            bucket.Add(card);
   421	        }
   422	
   423	        return TypeGroupOrder
   424	            .Where(byPrimaryType.ContainsKey)
   425	            .Select(typeLabel =>
   426	            {
   427	                List<CutLabPoolCard> cards = byPrimaryType[typeLabel];
   428	                return new CutLabRoleGroupView
   429	                {
   430	                    RoleKey = typeLabel,
   431	                    DisplayLabel = typeLabel,
   432	                    Members = cards
   433	                        .Select(card => new CutLabRoleMemberView
   434	                        {
   435	                            Name = card.Name,
   436	                            IsLocked = card.IsLocked,
   437	                            IsCommander = card.IsCommander,
   438	                        })
   439	                        .ToArray(),
   440	                    CardCount = cards.Sum(card => card.Quantity),
   441	                    LockedCount = cards.Where(card => card.IsLocked).Sum(card => card.Quantity),
   442	                };
   443	            })
   444	            .ToArray();
   445	    }

   447	    private static IReadOnlyList<CutLabFloorRowView> BuildFloorRows(
   448	        IReadOnlyList<CutLabResolvedFloor> resolvedFloors,
   449	        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> countsByRole,
   450	        string playExperience)
   451	    {
   452	        return resolvedFloors
   453	            .Select(floor =>
   454	            {
   455	                int inPoolCount = countsByRole.TryGetValue(floor.Role, out int count) ? count : 0;
   456	                return new CutLabFloorRowView
   457	                {
   458	                    RoleKey = floor.Role,
   459	                    DisplayLabel = DisplayLabelFor(floor.Role),
   460	                    InPoolCount = inPoolCount,
   461	                    Floor = floor.Floor,
   462	                    DefaultValue = floor.DefaultValue,
   463	                    IsUserSet = floor.IsUserSet,
   464	                    AtFloor = inPoolCount <= floor.Floor + 1,
   465	                    SourceLabel = floor.BracketWasFallback
   466	                        ? $"Default: {floor.DefaultValue} — based on {FallbackSource(playExperience)}"
   467	                        : $"Default for B{floor.ResolvedBracket}: {floor.DefaultValue}",
   468	                };
   469	            })
   470	            .ToArray();
   471	    }

   473	    private static IReadOnlyList<CutLabGoalRowView> BuildGoalRows(
   474	        CutLabGoalSettings goals,
   475	        CutLabMetricSnapshot? currentSnapshot,
   476	        CutLabMetricSnapshot? baselineSnapshot,
   477	        string playExperience)
   478	    {
   479	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(goals);
   480	
   481	        bool representativeLineIsUncapped = CutLabRoleAssigner.ResolveMode(playExperience) != ManabaseMode.Cedh;
   482	        IReadOnlyDictionary<CutLabMetricKind, CutLabMetricValue> currentByKind = currentSnapshot?.Metrics
   483	            .ToDictionary(metric => metric.Kind) ?? new Dictionary<CutLabMetricKind, CutLabMetricValue>();
   484	        IReadOnlyDictionary<CutLabMetricKind, CutLabMetricValue> baselineByKind = baselineSnapshot?.Metrics
   485	            .ToDictionary(metric => metric.Kind) ?? new Dictionary<CutLabMetricKind, CutLabMetricValue>();
   486	
   487	        return
   488	        [
   489	            BuildGoalRow(

   401	    private static string RoleLabelFor(
   402	        string cardName,
   403	        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, IReadOnlyList<string>> roleAssignmentsByCardName)
   404	        => roleAssignmentsByCardName.TryGetValue(cardName, out IReadOnlyList<string>? roles)

   408	    private static string JoinCardNames(IReadOnlyList<string> cardNames)
   409	        => cardNames.Count switch
   410	        {
   411	            0 => string.Empty,
   412	            1 => cardNames[0],
   413	            2 => $"{cardNames[0]} and {cardNames[1]}",
   414	            _ => $"{string.Join(", ", cardNames.Take(cardNames.Count - 1))} and {cardNames[^1]}",
   415	        };

 succeeded in 0ms:
     1	# 0003 — Ramp classifiers intentionally diverge; draw is shared
     2	
     3	Date: 2026-07-24
     4	
     5	## Context
     6	
     7	Two subsystems classify cards by role, and both need a notion of "ramp" and
     8	"draw":
     9	
    10	- **Role tally** — `DeckStatClassifier` (`DeckFlow.Core/Analysis`). Broad,
    11	  single-boolean predicates (`IsRampCard`, `IsDrawCard`) feeding the Cut Lab
    12	  role panel, the analysis prompt `deck_stats` counting aid, and the multi-axis
    13	  score. These are counting aids for a human/LLM reader — approximate is fine.
    14	- **Manabase math** — `ManabaseClassifier` (`DeckFlow.Core/Manabase`). Several
    15	  *tuned, flag-gated* ramp predicates (`IsRampPieceForBudget`,
    16	  `IsRepeatableRampOrDraw`, `IsRockOrDork`, `IsLandRampToBattlefield`) calibrated
    17	  for the castability simulator, the ramp/draw budget, and the Karsten −0.28
    18	  land-target credit. Precision matters: mis-counting one source shifts a land
    19	  recommendation.
    20	
    21	A reviewer (or a well-meaning "reconcile the duplication" pass) naturally wants
    22	to collapse these into one shared `IsRamp`. Doing so is a defect: the Manabase
    23	predicates deliberately differ from each other (`rampCreditV2` narrows the land
    24	credit vs the budget count) and from the broad role-tally boolean (they
    25	sac-guard Lotus Petal, are front-face-aware, and exclude one-shot rituals from
    26	persistent-source credit). A single boolean cannot serve both the "rough role
    27	count" and the "Karsten source weight" purposes.
    28	
    29	Draw is different. The robust, you-anchored literal-draw regex (originally
    30	`ManabaseClassifier.YouCardDrawRegex`) is correct for *both* purposes, so it was
    31	promoted to `DeckStatClassifier.MatchesYouCardDraw` and is now the single shared
    32	literal-draw signal (see the 2026-07-24 draw reconcile). The one intentional
    33	split that remains: `DeckStatClassifier.IsDrawCard` unions in `investigate` /
    34	`connive` (clue/connive card-advantage) for the *role tally*, while Manabase's
    35	draw term stays literal-draw only — clue/connive is card advantage but not a
    36	Karsten "draw", so it must not enter the Manabase draw budget or land credit.
    37	
    38	## Decision
    39	
    40	- **Ramp: do not unify.** `DeckStatClassifier.IsRampCard` (role tally) and the
    41	  Manabase ramp predicates stay separate by design. Changing one to match the
    42	  other is prohibited without re-deriving the Manabase calibration.
    43	- **Draw: shared regex, split union.** `MatchesYouCardDraw` (regex-only) is the
    44	  single literal-draw source both subsystems reuse. The `investigate`/`connive`
    45	  union lives only in `IsDrawCard` (role tally); Manabase's `IsYouCardDraw`
    46	  delegates to `MatchesYouCardDraw` and never sees the union.
    47	
    48	## Consequences
    49	
    50	- The same card can be "ramp"/"draw" in the Cut Lab role panel or analysis
    51	  `deck_stats` yet not credited in the Manabase land math (and vice-versa).
    52	  This is expected, not drift.
    53	- A change to `DeckStatClassifier.IsRampCard` can shift the analysis prompt and
    54	  Cut Lab roles but MUST NOT be assumed to leave Manabase output unchanged —
    55	  verify with the byte-identity + Manabase suites (a widening of `IsRampCard`
    56	  on 2026-07-24 required rebaselining the analysis/comparison goldens; see
    57	  commit history).
    58	- Reviews and automated cleanup passes must not report the ramp predicates as
    59	  cross-subsystem duplication.
    60	- Adding a card-advantage keyword (e.g. a future clue-like mechanic) to
    61	  `IsDrawCard` must NOT be propagated into Manabase's draw notion unless it is
    62	  genuinely a Karsten literal draw.

   177	    private static IEnumerable<CutLabFinding> ComputeCurveCongestion(IReadOnlyList<CutLabAnalyzedCard> pool)
   178	    {
   179	        IReadOnlyList<CutLabAnalyzedCard> nonlands = pool.Where(card => !card.IsLand).ToArray();
   180	        int nonlandCount = nonlands.Sum(card => card.Quantity);
   181	        if (nonlandCount == 0)
   182	        {
   183	            yield break;
   184	        }
   185	
   186	        foreach (IGrouping<string, CutLabAnalyzedCard> bucket in nonlands
   187	            .GroupBy(card => ManaValueBucket(card.ManaValue))
   188	            .OrderBy(group => BucketSortKey(group.Key)))
   189	        {
   190	            int count = bucket.Sum(card => card.Quantity);
   191	            double share = (double)count / nonlandCount;
   192	            if (share < CongestionShareThreshold || count < CongestionMinimumCards)
   193	            {
   194	                continue;
   195	            }
   196	
   197	            yield return new CutLabFinding(
   198	                CutLabFindingKind.CurveCongestion,
   199	                "Curve congestion",
   200	                $"{count} nonland cards sit at mana value {bucket.Key} — {FormatPercent(share)}% of your nonland pool.",
   201	                bucket.Select(card => new CutLabFindingEvidence(card.Name, card.ManaValue)).ToArray());
   202	        }

     6	/// <summary>
     7	/// Classifies a spell into its win-directed <see cref="PlanRole"/>s for the "plan presence" opener
     8	/// read. Pure: the caller (<see cref="ManabaseAnalysisService"/>) does the I/O — it fetches each
     9	/// card's crowd-sourced categories and the Commander Spellbook combo-piece set — and passes them in.
    10	/// Source precedence is FIRST-HIT-WINS per the locked plan-presence decisions:
    11	/// <list type="number">
    12	/// <item>crowd categories (a card's Archidekt category tags → role);</item>
    13	/// <item>Commander Spellbook combo piece → <see cref="PlanRole.TutorCombo"/>;</item>
    14	/// <item>an oracle-text heuristic fallback (<see cref="DeckStatClassifier"/>).</item>
    15	/// </list>
    16	/// Ramp, lands, and filler card draw deliberately never earn a role — that is resource/velocity, a
    17	/// different axis already measured by keepable-% and on-curve castability. The <see cref="ManabaseMode"/>
    18	/// tunes one role: a pure counterspell counts as <see cref="PlanRole.Interaction"/> only in
    19	/// <see cref="ManabaseMode.Cedh"/> (it protects the combo turn); in Casual a counter is reactive
    20	/// insurance, not a card that advances the win plan, so it earns nothing. The classifier also exposes
    21	/// a pre-permanent-gate interaction signal for the cEDH early-interaction lens, while leaving the
    22	/// returned plan-presence roles unchanged.
    23	/// </summary>
    24	public static class PlanRoleClassifier
    25	{

    27	    /// Resolve a card's plan roles. Categories win when they map to any role; otherwise a known combo
    28	    /// piece is <see cref="PlanRole.TutorCombo"/>; otherwise the oracle-text heuristic decides. Returns

    36	        => Classify(fact, categories, isComboPiece, mode, out _);

    38	    /// <summary>
    39	    /// Resolve a card's plan roles, while also reporting whether it earned
    40	    /// <see cref="PlanRole.Interaction"/> before the permanent gate strips one-shot instants/sorceries.
    41	    /// The returned value is byte-identical to <see cref="Classify(CardFact, IReadOnlyList{string}, bool, ManabaseMode)"/>.
    42	    /// </summary>
    43	    public static PlanRole Classify(
    44	        CardFact fact,
    45	        IReadOnlyList<string> categories,
    46	        bool isComboPiece,
    47	        ManabaseMode mode,
    48	        out bool interactionMeritPreGate)
    49	    {
    50	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(fact);
    51	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(categories);
    52	
    53	        // Resolve roles first (categories → combo piece → heuristic, first-hit-wins), THEN apply the
    54	        // permanent gate below to whatever won.
    55	        PlanRole roles;
    56	        PlanRole fromCategories = FromCategories(categories, mode);
    57	        if (fromCategories != PlanRole.None)
    58	        {
    59	            roles = fromCategories;
    60	        }
    61	        else if (isComboPiece)
    62	        {
    63	            roles = PlanRole.TutorCombo;
    64	        }
    65	        else
    66	        {
    67	            roles = FromHeuristic(fact, mode);
    68	        }
    69	
    70	        interactionMeritPreGate = roles.HasFlag(PlanRole.Interaction);
    71	
    72	        // PERMANENT gate (user decisions 2026-07-09): a hand "has a plan" when it holds a card that
    73	        // advances the win castable on curve. PAYOFF and INTERACTION require a PERMANENT — a one-shot
    74	        // burn/extra-turn finisher (Torment of Hailfire) or a one-shot removal/counter (Swords,
    75	        // Counterspell) leaves nothing on the board, so it is not by itself a plan. TUTORS and CARD-DRAW
    76	        // (TutorCombo / Engine) still count even as instants/sorceries: a sorcery tutor (Demonic Tutor)
    77	        // points at the permanent win, and card advantage furthers the plan. So for a non-permanent front
    78	        // face we strip only the permanent-only roles and keep the rest. (The lower-level
    79	        // FromCategories/FromHeuristic detectors stay type-agnostic; the type rule lives here, at the
    80	        // single service entry.)
    81	        if (CardTypeLine.IsNonPermanentFront(fact.TypeLine))
    82	        {
    83	            roles &= ~PermanentOnlyRoles;
    84	        }
    85	
    86	        return roles;
    87	    }
    88	
    89	    // Roles that only "count" on a permanent: a board threat (Payoff) and reactive interaction that must
    90	    // stick to matter. TutorCombo and Engine are deliberately absent — they advance the plan even as a
    91	    // one-shot instant/sorcery.
    92	    private const PlanRole PermanentOnlyRoles = PlanRole.Payoff | PlanRole.Interaction;

   197	        bool isSpellOnTheStack = typeLine.Contains("Instant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
   198	            || typeLine.Contains("Sorcery", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
   199	        if (DeckStatClassifier.IsDrawCard(oracle) && !isSpellOnTheStack)
   200	        {
   201	            roles |= PlanRole.Engine;
   202	        }
   203	
   204	        return roles;
   205	    }

**Findings**

- **High: bug #2’s proposed fix is incomplete, and one of its key precedent claims is false.** The plan says `PlanRoleClassifier.cs:176` already uses front-face-first oracle precedence, but the real code is still reversed at [PlanRoleClassifier.cs](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Web/Services/Manabase/PlanRoleClassifier.cs:176): `fact.OracleText ?? fact.FrontFaceOracleText ?? string.Empty`. `CutLabRoleAssigner.AssignRoles` delegates into that classifier at [CutLabRoleAssigner.cs](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Web/Services/CutLab/CutLabRoleAssigner.cs:75). So changing only the local `oracle` at [CutLabRoleAssigner.cs](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Web/Services/CutLab/CutLabRoleAssigner.cs:73) does **not** fully stop back-face bleed for category-less cards; heuristic `Payoff`/`TutorCombo`/`Interaction`/`Engine` can still be derived from joined back-face text via `PlanRoleClassifier.FromHeuristic` at [PlanRoleClassifier.cs](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Web/Services/Manabase/PlanRoleClassifier.cs:171). This needs a plan revision and a write-set expansion.

- **High: bug #4’s write set is too small; an implementer can follow the plan and still leave failing tests or inconsistent UI.** If `CutLabViewModel.BuildRoleGroups` starts appending `"other"`, [CutLabPageServiceTests.cs](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Web.Tests/CutLabPageServiceTests.cs:2017) will fail because it currently asserts `model.RoleGroups.Select(group => group.RoleKey)` equals `CutLabFloorRules.RoleKeys` exactly. That test file is outside the plan’s `WRITE SET`. Separately, live-patch UI uses a second role-label map in [CutLabUiPatchBuilder.cs](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Web/Services/CutLab/CutLabUiPatchBuilder.cs:35) and formats role labels through [CutLabUiPatchBuilder.cs](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Web/Services/CutLab/CutLabUiPatchBuilder.cs:401) and [418]. If `"other"` reaches that path, it will render as raw `"other"`, not `"Other"`. That file is also outside `WRITE SET`.

- **Medium: the plan’s “align with Manabase” rationale is only partly true.** The cited Manabase precedent in [ManabaseClassifier.cs](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Core/Manabase/ManabaseClassifier.cs:1097), [1156], and [1841] is real front-face-first usage, but the specific `PlanRoleClassifier` claim is not. So the repo does show a valid precedent, just not the one the plan names.

- **Low: the reminder-text stripping fix looks sound, and I do not see a better repo-local alternative.** The shared draw path is exactly [DeckStatClassifier.MatchesYouCardDraw](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Core/Analysis/DeckStatClassifier.cs:55), called by [DeckStatClassifier.IsDrawCard](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Core/Analysis/DeckStatClassifier.cs:62) and Manabase’s [IsYouCardDraw](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Core/Manabase/ManabaseClassifier.cs:1790). The exact same parenthetical-strip regex already exists in Manabase at [ManabaseClassifier.cs](/mnt/c/users/chrislunt/source/personal/deckflow-cutlab-fixes/DeckFlow.Core/Manabase/ManabaseClassifier.cs:907). I do not see an obvious new false positive/negative from applying that same normalization before the draw regex, beyond the same simple `\([^)]*\)` limitations the repo already accepts elsewhere.
